设计意图： This factor combines smooth directional consistency (from parent stability factor) with crash risk measured by negative skewness (from crash skew parent). By downweighting the stability signal when crash risk is high, it aims to preserve the strength of the stability factor during normal regimes while protecting against false trends during extreme risk periods. The rank normalization of crash skew

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
power计算 x 的 y 次方
rank截面 0-1 排名
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)
ts_var滚动方差（样本方差）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 volume：volume
  3. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  4. 计算 ema_ret：ret.ewm(span=21, min_periods=21).mean()
  5. 计算 ema_absret：ret.abs().ewm(span=21, min_periods=21).mean()
  6. 计算 ratio：ema_ret / ema_absret
  7. 计算 sma_vol：volume.滚动窗口(21, min_periods=21).mean()
  8. 计算 vol_factor：volume / sma_vol
  9. 计算 sdc：ratio * vol_factor
  10. 计算 N：20
  11. 计算 rolling_mean：ret.rolling(N).mean()
  12. 计算 rolling_m2：(ret**2).rolling(N).mean()
  13. 计算 rolling_m3：(ret**3).rolling(N).mean()
  14. 计算 central_m3：rolling_m3 - 3*rolling_mean*rolling_m2 + 2*rolling_mean**3
  15. 计算 rolling_var_pop：ret.rolling(N).var(ddof=0)
  16. 计算 rolling_std_pop：rolling_var_pop ** 0.5
  17. 计算 skewness：central_m3 / (rolling_std_pop**3)
  18. 计算 cs：-skewness
  19. 计算 cs_rank：cs.rank(pct=True)
  20. 计算 factor：sdc * (1 - cs_rank)
  21. 计算 factor：factor
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

  3. SMA(vol,21) — SMA(x, n) → 简单均线

"kw">class="kw">def factor_stability_crash_guard(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] ret = close.pct_change() "com"># SDC: smooth directional consistency ema_ret = ret.ewm(span=21, min_periods=21).mean() ema_absret = ret.abs().ewm(span=21, min_periods=21).mean() ratio = ema_ret / ema_absret.replace(0, np.nan) sma_vol = volume.rolling(21, min_periods=21).mean() vol_factor = volume / sma_vol.replace(0, np.nan) sdc = ratio * vol_factor "com"># CS: crash skew (negative skewness, inverted so high values = high crash risk) N = 20 rolling_mean = ret.rolling(N).mean() rolling_m2 = (ret**2).rolling(N).mean() rolling_m3 = (ret**3).rolling(N).mean() central_m3 = rolling_m3 - 3*rolling_mean*rolling_m2 + 2*rolling_mean**3 rolling_var_pop = ret.rolling(N).var(ddof=0) rolling_std_pop = rolling_var_pop ** 0.5 skewness = central_m3 / (rolling_std_pop**3).replace(0, np.nan) cs = -skewness "com"># Normalize cs to [0,1] using rank cs_rank = cs.rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True).fillna(0.5) "com"># Combine: reduce SDC when crash risk is high factor = sdc * (1 - cs_rank) factor = factor.fillna(0) df_copy["str">'factor_stability_crash_guard'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_stability_crash_guard']
